source: synthetic traffic dataset empirical p95 calibration
limitations: Latency and packet-loss thresholds are descriptive percentiles of the existing simplified QoS model.
They are not independently validated application SLAs or real 5G performance guarantees.
Packet loss is a proxy for unserved demand, not measured network packet loss.
The calibrated URLLC latency value must not be presented as a validated URLLC latency requirement.
